comparison.method: Compare full recursive tracked tree entries (mode, kind and object ID) at both tips; independently match saved pre-rebase SHA256 manifest against working files.

scope: Earlier local test receipts retain their original execution identity. Exact tracked source, fixtures, dependency selections and evidence bytes are identical at the rebased tip. This append only records rebase provenance; final hosted acceptance must name the actual pushed head.
push: Prior ordinary push refused non-fast-forward; no force push used. Rebase preserves external boundary adoption and newer owner descendants.
